rows.label: Athena
rows.description: goddess of wisdom and war in ancient Greek religion and mythology
rows.hook: sprang fully grown from her father's forehead and became the wise patron of a great ancient city

rows.label: Zeus
rows.description: Greek god of the sky and king of the gods
rows.hook: ruled from a mountain peak, hurling lightning bolts as the supreme king of the sky

rows.label: Aphrodite
rows.description: Greek goddess of love, beauty, pleasure, and procreation
rows.hook: rose from sea foam as the embodiment of beauty and desire, sparking a legendary war

rows.label: Artemis
rows.description: goddess of the hunt and the wild in ancient Greek religion and mythology
rows.hook: roamed the wilds with a silver bow, protecting animals and women in childbirth

rows.label: Hecate
rows.description: Greek goddess
rows.hook: carried twin torches and ruled over crossroads, witchcraft, and the night

rows.label: Poseidon
rows.description: one of the twelve Olympians presiding over the sea, storms, earthquakes and horses
rows.hook: struck the ground with a trident to raise storms, earthquakes, and crashing waves

rows.label: Hera
rows.description: Greek goddess, wife and sister of Zeus
rows.hook: presided over marriage and family from a golden throne, famously jealous of her husband's affairs

rows.label: Hephaestus
rows.description: Greek god of blacksmiths
rows.hook: forged weapons and armor at a fiery underground smithy despite a lame leg

rows.label: Ares
rows.description: Greek god of war and combat
rows.hook: charged into battle craving bloodshed and chaos more than glory

rows.label: Demeter
rows.description: Greek goddess of the harvest, grains, and agriculture
rows.hook: made crops grow and mourned each year when her daughter was taken to the underworld

rows.label: Helios
rows.description: Greek god and personification of the Sun
rows.hook: drove a blazing chariot across the sky each day to bring daylight

rows.label: Eros
rows.description: Greek god of love and sex
rows.hook: shot arrows that made mortals and gods fall helplessly in love

rows.label: Hestia
rows.description: Greek goddess of the hearth and the home
rows.hook: tended the sacred hearth fire and never left home for any romance or quarrel

rows.label: Pan
rows.description: Greek god of the mountain wilds, shepherds, flocks, rustic music, fertility, spring, and theatrical criticism, with the hindquarters, legs, and horns of a goat
rows.hook: had the legs and horns of a goat and played haunting tunes on a reed pipe in the forest

rows.label: Nike
rows.description: goddess of victory in Greek mythology
rows.hook: flew down with outstretched wings to crown the winners of contests and battles

rows.label: Asclepius
rows.description: Greek god of medicine
rows.hook: carried a snake-wrapped staff and could heal the sick or even raise the dead

rows.label: Thanatos
rows.description: personification of death in Greek mythology
rows.hook: arrived gently to carry mortal souls away at the moment of death

rows.label: Eris
rows.description: Greek goddess of discord
rows.hook: tossed a golden apple among goddesses just to watch them quarrel over who was fairest

rows.label: Eos
rows.description: Greek goddess of the dawn
rows.hook: opened the gates of the sky each morning with rosy fingers to bring the dawn

rows.label: Amphitrite
rows.description: Oceanid or Nereid of Greek mythology
rows.hook: ruled the deep sea at her husband's side, surrounded by dolphins and sea creatures

rows.label: Hypnos
rows.description: personification of sleep in Greek mythology
rows.hook: lived in a cave of silence and put mortals and gods alike into deep sleep

rows.label: Hebe
rows.description: ancient Greek goddess of youth
rows.hook: poured nectar for the gods and embodied eternal youth at their feasts
